reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input 'param' from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to 'host' variable, which is used in DNS resolution (line 40) AND the outbound URL fetch (line 41). The isNonPublicAddress check only blocks certain reserved addresses but does not comprehensively prevent SSRF attacks. Attacker-controlled input reaches the URL sink expression with unresolved sink value depending on user input. The separate DNS-resolve-and-fetch pattern creates SSRF risk.

evidence.note: User param -> host variable -> DNS resolve (line 40) -> URL fetch (line 41)
